title: fix(i18n): a tenant's rewrite of an extension-contributed validation rule message is served as written, on the refusal and on /meta
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4iKDikdsAexd39K77jgeJh)_

domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytRisTLYYDef35A9G

Fixes #27559

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `SchemaRegistry` (`@objectstack/objectql`) gains the public read `getPackagedObjectBase(name)`
Metadata-protocol: semantic

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：租户在 overlay 里改写了“扩展包”（objectExtensions）带来的校验规则提示语后，非默认语言下拒收报错和 /meta 仍回扩展包译文；现在两处都拿“owner + 代码扩展包”这一套打包规则做比较，改写的照原样显示，没改的照常翻译。
- 为什么改：#27543 只拿 owner 的声明比较，扩展包的规则无从比较，租户为自己用户改的话一换语言就变回扩展包译文；折叠里还会出现两条同名规则，拒收同时报两句。
- 风险与回滚：只扩 validations 一项（label/description 仍只认 owner，#8037 不受影响）；折叠里 overlay 带的同名规则顶替扩展包原规则（仅当 owner 未声明该名），owner 与扩展包同名规则仍并存。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`（`getPackagedObjectBase`、`tenantCarriedRuleNames`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-validation-messages.ts`（`packagedRuleLookup`）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`（`getPackagedObjectBase`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts src/protocol-packaged-object-base.test.ts`，预期 16 passed：zh-CN/zh/en 下 /meta 与拒收是同一句，扩展规则改写为租户原句、只出现一次。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（欠一次契约复审，席位安排）。

## What changes

ADR-0029 D9.2a compares a served rule message with the packaged rule of the same name. Since #27543 the packaged side was the OWNER's declaration only, so a rule a second package contributes through `objectExtensions` had nothing to compare with, and the catalog won over a tenant's rewrite on both readers.

- **One packaged rule set, both readers.** `SchemaRegistry.getPackagedObjectBase(name)` (new, beside `getPackagedObjectOwner`) answers the packaged owner's declaration with each CODE `extend` contributor's `validations` appended in fold order. By reference when no code extender ships a rule; `undefined` exactly where `getPackagedObjectOwner` is. `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getPackagedObjectBase` (what `/meta` hands `translateObject` as `packagedBase`) and `packagedRuleLookup` (what the rule evaluator judges the refusal by) both read it; a registry double without it is still read through `getPackagedObjectOwner`, the owner alone. The comparison stays `valueOverridesPackagedBase` / `scalarOverridesPackagedBase`, unchanged.
- **⛔ The object scalars' base is not widened.** Only `validations` gains the extenders' entries; `label` / `pluralLabel` / `description` stay the owner's, so an extension's label still reads as diverged and keeps winning over the owner's catalog (#8037). Pinned.
- **The fold (design choice the card left open).** An extender's top-level rule yields to a rule of the same name that the fold's BASE carries and the `own` contributor does NOT declare (`tenantCarriedRuleNames`, computed once over the base, the rule-name mirror of `tenantAuthoredScalars`). On an overlay base those are the tenant's copies of extender rules (a Studio GET → edit → PUT stores the folded object), so the rule is served and evaluated once, as the tenant last wrote it. Conservative edges, as for the scalars: no `own` contributor, or a base that IS the owner (every no-overlay read and `resolveOwnerLayer`), returns `undefined` and the fold concatenates exactly as before; a name the owner declares itself is not counted, so an owner rule and an extender rule sharing a name stay two rules (pinned). Composes with #8027's `subtractExtenderContributions` (that runs first, on `foldObjectExtendersOnto`).
- **Prose** (seat-granted surface amendment, prose only): `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` docblocks of `TranslateDocumentOptions.packagedBase` and `translateObjectValidations`; `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`, the validation-rule paragraph of "An edit beats the packaged catalog". No predicate change in `packages/spec`.
- ⛔ `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` is not edited (held by #27897): its `packagedObjectBaseOf` already calls the protocol's `getPackagedObjectBase`, which now carries the extenders' rules.

## Why

A tenant who rewords a rule an add-on package ships, for their own users, saw it revert to the add-on's translation whenever a user's locale differed from the default, and the refusal also carried the add-on's original rule beside the tenant's.

## Verification

Card probe re-run on `main` `784dc9ae` (real `ObjectQL` engine + `SchemaRegistry`; owner `px_duty` with no rules, an `extend` contributor adding `ext_blocked` "Say what is blocking the duty.", a zh-CN bundle entry, a tenant overlay; not committed). Locale zh-CN:

| Case | Reading | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| no overlay | fold / `/meta` / refusal | 1 rule / `请写明阻塞原因。` / `请写明阻塞原因。` | unchanged |
| overlay rewords `ext_blocked` to "Tell us what blocks this duty." | fold | 2 rules (rewrite + appended original) | 1 rule (the rewrite) |
| | `/meta` | `请写明阻塞原因。`, `请写明阻塞原因。` | `Tell us what blocks this duty.` |
| | refusal | `请写明阻塞原因。 \| 请写明阻塞原因。` | `Tell us what blocks this duty.` |
| overlay carries `ext_blocked` untouched | fold / `/meta` / refusal | 2 rules / translated twice / translated twice | 1 rule / `请写明阻塞原因。` / `请写明阻塞原因。` |

Pins (red first on `main`, 6 red; all green after):
- `engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts`: an overlay rewording the extension rule is served and refused as written on zh-CN / zh / en, folded once; an overlay carrying it untouched is folded once and translated on both readers; the #27543 owner-rule rows unchanged (the packaged-base assertion now also lists the extension rule). The refusal reader now joins every violation, so a duplicated rule shows.
- `protocol-packaged-object-base.test.ts`: the packaged base appends the extender's rules while `label` stays the owner's (#8037); by reference when no extender ships a rule; unmoved by an overlay rewording an extender rule; owner + extender same-name rules both still folded.

Ablations (each restored, suite green after):
- A1 `getPackagedObjectBase` answers the owner only → 4 red (both readers).
- A2 fold yield off → 3 red (fold count, both readers).
- A3 `packagedRuleLookup` reads the owner only → 1 red (refusal reader alone).

Suites: `@objectstack/objectql` full vitest 492 files / 9264 tests pass; `@objectstack/rest` i18n override files (4 files / 109 tests) pass against the rebuilt dists; `objectql` + `metadata-protocol` typecheck pass. `dispatch-gates --commands` (107 families, derived on a tree identical to head `5697abaa`) and `pnpm lint`: see the os-dev report comment on #27559.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (docblock-only on a non-schema interface; `check:docs` / `check:api-surface` green).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
